report.summary:
Patient P-D009 (73F, Medicare Advantage/Lakeshore Senior PPO, home tract 17031720500) was seen today V-D009. CMS screener (2026-10-19) reports no transportation difficulty and no utility shutoff risk; appointment appt:1 (cardiology) was kept. Tract profile: 26 transit stops within 800 m with early service, very low no-vehicle share (0.4%), suggesting good local transit access. A transit-trip check could not be completed because no facility location is on file for the appointment.

Utilities options: (1) Shutoff Prevention Clinic — walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays; (2) Neighborhood Energy Help — income-based gas/electric bill assistance, apply in person Mon/Wed; (3) Utility assistance pre-application (form H3) — submit to check what the patient qualifies for, response within one business day (needs name, address, account number, household income — not on file, so patient/clinic must complete).

Transport options: (1) Senior Shuttle West — free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM; patient is age 73 so appears age-eligible; (2) Paratransit Info Desk — ADA paratransit certification by phone, decisions up to 21 days; (3) Medicaid Ride Line — not applicable (patient has Medicare, not Medicaid).
